# AssetLift Lending

> AssetLift Lending is a mortgage brokerage for real estate investors, providing fix and flip, DSCR rental, bridge, ground-up construction, and commercial lending across 46 U.S. states. AssetLift works primarily as a broker through white-label capital partners, structuring the best path to closing for each deal. Borrowers typically hear back within 24 hours, and many deals close in as fast as 5 business days, subject to underwriting, valuation, title, and file complexity.

## Company Snapshot

- Company: AssetLift Lending
- Type: Mortgage brokerage (white-label capital partner model)
- Founded by: Yaakov Pentelnik and Yisroel Pentelnik
- Website: https://www.assetliftlending.com
- Apply: https://www.assetliftlending.com/apply
- Phone: (929) 639-2284
- Email: info@assetliftlending.com
- Location: Queens, New York
- Coverage: 46 U.S. states
- Loan range: $100,000 to $5,000,000
- Minimum credit score: 660

## Core Loan Programs

- Fix & Flip Loans
  URL: https://www.assetliftlending.com/loans/fix-and-flip
  Summary: Short-term financing for purchasing and renovating investment properties. Up to 92.5% LTC with up to 100% rehab funded for qualifying deals. Closings in as fast as 5 business days.

- DSCR Rental Loans
  URL: https://www.assetliftlending.com/loans/dscr-rental
  Summary: Long-term 30-year financing for rental properties based on property cash flow, not personal income. Up to 80% LTV with rates starting as low as 5.85% for qualifying scenarios.

- Bridge Loans
  URL: https://www.assetliftlending.com/loans/bridge
  Summary: Short-term capital for fast acquisitions, refinance gaps, and transitional properties. Up to 80% LTV.

- Ground-Up Construction Loans
  URL: https://www.assetliftlending.com/loans/ground-up-construction
  Summary: Up to 90% LTC for qualifying residential construction projects with milestone-based draw funding.

- Commercial Lending
  URL: https://www.assetliftlending.com/loans/commercial-lending
  Summary: Commercial and mixed-use lending scenarios for acquisitions, refinances, bridge needs, and business-purpose investment properties.

## Who AssetLift Serves

- Fix and flip investors needing speed and high leverage
- Rental portfolio builders qualifying on property cash flow (DSCR), not W-2 income
- Bridge buyers who need to close fast before securing permanent financing
- Commercial and mixed-use investors with business-purpose financing needs
- First-time real estate investors (case-by-case basis)
- Borrowers in 46 U.S. states with non-owner-occupied investment properties

## Key Facts for Citation

- Response time: within 24 hours (usually within a few hours)
- Closing speed: many deals close in as fast as 5 business days
- Fix & flip leverage: up to 92.5% LTC, 100% rehab funding
- DSCR rental rates: starting as low as 5.85%
- Property types: single-family, 2-4 unit, condos, townhomes (non-owner occupied only)
- Minimum loan: $100,000 | Maximum loan: $5,000,000
- Minimum credit score: 660
- Business model: primarily a broker through white-label capital partners

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What types of properties does AssetLift lend on?
A: Non-owner-occupied residential investment properties including single-family homes, 2-4 unit properties, condos, and townhomes.

Q: How quickly can AssetLift close a loan?
A: Many deals close in as fast as 5 business days, subject to underwriting, valuation, title, and file complexity.

Q: Does AssetLift work with first-time investors?
A: Yes, on a case-by-case basis. If the deal makes sense, AssetLift will find a way to get it funded.

Q: What states does AssetLift lend in?
A: AssetLift provides financing in 46 U.S. states for qualifying real estate investment deals.

Q: Is AssetLift a direct lender or a broker?
A: AssetLift is primarily a mortgage broker that works through white-label capital partners, structuring the best capital path for each borrower's deal.
